value.rationale: The power-law per-departure internal hazard is a natural scale-free extension of existing inverse-state reset laws for accelerating CTRWs. Its threshold controls whether infinitely many jumps occur within finite physical time, and the explicit Gamma amplitude and exponential clock law quantify the large observation-time discrepancy near criticality. This is a motivated physical qualitative boundary plus asymptotic distribution, not an arbitrary parameter slice or numerical table.
